One effective way to learn a new language quickly is to use the Leitner Flashcard Method. This technique involves organizing flashcards into different levels based on how well you know each concept. This method ensures you focus more on difficult material while reviewing easier content less often, helping to maximize efficiency and improve long-term retention.
